additional_info.subject: RE: ID0468503-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multi] Update Charger Firmware CRM:03288000072
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Schneider,
I am reaching out form the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0468503.
The ticket has been opened to request FW update activation on #24 chargers.
The FW updates have to be manually initiated and cannot be scheduled automatically, and from our team we only work from 9am - 6pm CET.
If you agree, please let me know if I can proceed with the FW updates during this timeframe. I would initiate the updates when the chargers are not in use.
Otherwise, we would need to ask the regional field service team to do it, since we don't work after hours without an SLA.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
